title: MTCAT v2.0: Magnetotelluric Catalogue interchange document
description: Discovery interchange document for magnetotelluric survey and station holdings. Semantics are defined by the MTCAT specification; this schema enforces the machine-checkable layer. Record objects keep additionalProperties true so later minor versions and local extensions never break validation; described fields are strictly typed and vocabulary fields are enum-pinned.

portal.description: identity of the portal that produced this document

portal_id.description: stable opaque identity token of the producing catalogue; never changes across rebuilds or host migrations, and global keys pair it with survey_id or station_id

version.description: schema version this document conforms to, as major.minor

schema_url.description: location of this schema served beside the document, relative or absolute, so a harvester can validate without resolving the canonical $id

metadata_license.description: licence of the catalogue metadata itself, distinct from per-survey data licences, e.g. an SPDX identifier

generated_at.description: UTC build timestamp of this document, ISO 8601

survey_id.description: stable discovery identifier of this survey record within the producing catalogue

organisation.description: organisation with primary custodial responsibility for the represented dataset

doi.description: persistent DOI of the exact dataset or release this record represents, bare form; never a containing collection, report, or activity identifier

access.description: normalised access level; open, metadata_only and embargoed are the well-known values. Deliberately not enum-pinned: an unrecognised value means a withheld survey, not a broken document

embargo_until.description: date a declared embargo lapses; absent means no declared end date, not open access

bbox.description: geographic footprint derived from published station coordinates; omitted when no station is located

centroid.description: centre of the bbox; omitted when no station is located

n_stations.description: count of this survey's station records in stations[]

data_types.description: band mix as counts per data_type, using the stations[].data_type vocabulary; omitted when the survey has no stations

period_min_s.description: shortest period in seconds across the represented transfer functions; omitted when none reports a range

period_max_s.description: longest period in seconds across the represented transfer functions; omitted when none reports a range

n_stations_tipper.description: how many of this survey's stations carry a tipper; at most n_stations

formats.description: distribution formats this catalogue currently serves for the survey; emitted only when at least one format is distributed, omitted otherwise (no empty-array state)

year_start.description: first declared year of acquisition; omitted when undeclared, never inferred from file timestamps

year_end.description: last declared year of acquisition; equal to year_start for a single season

version.description: semantic version of the represented dataset release

collection_id.description: collection this survey belongs to, matching a collections[].collection_id

organisation_ror.description: ROR identifier of the custodian organisation

raid.description: identifier of the related research activity, emitted only when exactly one activity is asserted; surveys with several related activities omit it and express them in richer linked metadata

creators.description: citation authors of the release, in citation order; the order is preserved verbatim by consumers

orcid.description: ORCID iD of a person creator, bare or as a full URL; omitted when none

ror.description: ROR identifier of an organisation creator; omitted when none

contributors.description: who did what on the release, as DataCite contributors, in declared order; a hosting-portal row with role HostingInstitution may be appended by the producer

role.description: DataCite contributorType; HostingInstitution is reserved for the appended portal row and is not declared by a survey

orcid.description: ORCID iD of a person contributor, bare or as a full URL; omitted when none

ror.description: ROR identifier of an organisation contributor; omitted when none

related_identifiers.description: typed links to related records; present only when the survey declares at least one

identifier.description: the identifier itself, bare form for DOIs

identifier_type.description: kind of identifier; omitted when undeclared

relation.description: DataCite relationType, read as 'this survey, relation, that record', chosen case by case for the true relation; a HasMetadata target must genuinely provide metadata about the dataset, never an inventory or manifest; omitted when undeclared

identifies.description: what the identifier points at, in data-level terms: collection is the parent record, raw_packed is raw or packed time series, level0 edited time series, level1 transformed time series, level2 processed frequency-domain data, level3 models, entire one record covering all levels; absent on legacy rows means level not stated

resolution.description: whether the identifier currently resolves: ok, or reserved (registered but not yet active); absent means unknown, never broken

scheme.description: for HasMetadata rows, the metadata family at the target, e.g. mt_metadata, ISO19115, DataCite

attribution.description: rights declaration of this release; present only when declared

custodian.description: rights holder of record, which may differ from the acquiring organisation

statement.description: attribution wording to reproduce verbatim, never reformatted or abbreviated

changes_made.description: whether this release changed the upstream material

changes_summary.description: plain-language summary of the changes, when changes_made is true

declared_date.description: date of the declaration, not of the data

description.description: concise discovery blurb for the dataset this record represents; complements, never replaces, the source's own documentation

code.description: the classification code within the named scheme, e.g. 370602

scheme.description: explicit scheme token; registered tokens bind the token to a scheme URI so code and scheme pairs compare across producers

label.description: human-readable label of the concept, for consumers that cannot resolve the scheme

uri.description: stable concept URI governed by the scheme's authority, where one exists

items.description: one thematic subject as a controlled, optionally labelled, optionally resolvable concept

subjects.description: thematic classification of the represented dataset for discovery and cross-catalogue mapping; absent means no assertion

sample_rates_hz.description: distinct acquisition sample rates known to be represented in the survey, in Hz; discrete modes, never an extent, taken only from explicit acquisition metadata and never inferred from instrument capability or period coverage; canonicalised and sorted ascending

n_stations_time_series_verified.description: count of this survey's station records carrying has_time_series true; a count of verified existence, stable across access transitions, never subtracted from n_stations to infer absence

coordinates_state.description: how published coordinates relate to acquisition positions; over mixed per-station states: all exact means exact, all withheld means withheld, any other mixture means generalised. The state is public, the reason need not be; absence makes no assertion. A withheld state forbids bbox and centroid (they would republish the withheld footprint)

station_id.description: identifier of this published station record, unique within the document

survey_id.description: the surveys[].survey_id this station belongs to

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees; may be deliberately generalised per the survey's coordinates_state. Null is defined: the position is not published (withheld under policy, or unlocated)

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees; see the latitude note; null means the position is not published

data_type.description: band class derived from the shortest period and the transfer functions present: AMT under 1e-3 s, BBMT under 1 s, LPMT long period, GDS tipper-only with no impedance, unknown when no period range could be read

has_time_series.description: present with value true when the producing catalogue has positively verified that a time-series resource for this station exists; existence semantics, with access a separate question; absence makes no assertion and false is never emitted

items.description: one published station record; latitude and longitude are either both numeric or both null (a half-null position is invalid) - both null means the position is not published

collections.description: optional groupings of related surveys, e.g. a programme; discovery rollup only, with all scientific provenance staying on member surveys

collection_id.description: id member surveys reference via surveys[].collection_id, by exact string match

status.description: lifecycle state; active, completed and archived are the well-known values; deliberately not enum-pinned

start_year.description: year the programme began, as declared by member surveys; omitted when none declares one

last_updated.description: curation date of the programme description, not an acquisition date and not this document's generated_at

n_surveys.description: how many surveys belong to this collection

n_stations.description: total stations across the member surveys

bbox.description: footprint across every member survey's stations; omitted when none is located

centroid.description: mean of member station positions, unlike a survey centroid which is the centre of its bbox; omitted when none is located
